result.summary: Found 4 issues including a cut-off content card, truncated text, and layout overflow problems affecting the horizontal scrolling sections.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccolo) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only partial content
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll indicators are visible or adjust card width/spacing so cards are either fully visible or clearly indicate scrollability

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' appears truncated at the edge of the screen without ellipsis or proper text wrapping
issues.suggestion: Add text truncation with ellipsis (...) or ensure the card container properly clips/wraps text

issues.description: The promotional banner with '-0%' badge shows a discount of 0%, which is confusing/meaningless to display
issues.suggestion: Remove the badge if there's no actual discount, or only show promotional badges when there's a genuine discount value

issues.description: Bottom pizza promotional card is abruptly cut off at the bottom of the visible screen without clear indication of additional scrollable content
issues.suggestion: Add fade gradient or visual cue at the bottom edge to indicate more content is available below
